title: U.S. Links Chinese Satellite Imagery to Iran Strike that Killed 3 Troops
text:
US officials say Chinese entities supplied Iran with satellite imagery of a US base in Jordan before and after Tehran's July 17 missile strike that killed three American troops. President Donald Trump later downplayed the report, saying that China also spied on the US like it does.

(DCNF)—Chinese entities reportedly aided Iran in a recent lethal attack against American service members stationed in the region. Iran obtained high-resolution satellite imagery from Chinese entities before launching a July 17 strike which killed three American service members and injured four others at the Muwaffaq Salti Air Base in Jordan, the Wall Street Journal reported […]

Chinese entities provided Iran with satellite images of a base in Jordan housing US troops before and after an attack that killed three Americans, The Wall Street Journal reported.
